tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.question:
I found Cobalt Labs's invoices, but there are **two approved (unpaid) invoices**, so I want to confirm which one you mean before sending money:

| Invoice | Amount | Due | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-34905 | $5,983.10 | 2026-11-04 | Approved |
| INV-36824 | $1,652.34 | 2026-11-25 | Approved |

(Their other invoices are already paid (INV-47379) or still awaiting approval (INV-72843).)

Should I pay both approved invoices, or just one? If just one, please confirm the invoice number. Once you confirm, I'll send the wire payment(s) from the operating account and report back with the details.

trace.message: Pay INV-36824, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-36824, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
Done! Here's the payment report:

- **Invoice:** INV-36824 (Cobalt Labs)
- **Amount:** $1,652.34 — paid in full
- **Rail:** Wire (from the operating account)
- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Status:** Sent; invoice marked as paid

The disputed invoice INV-34905 was left unpaid as requested. The payment was executed exactly once, with an idempotency key to guard against any duplicate processing.
